name: sendcutsend
description: SendCutSend-ready in one step: run cutcheck (SendCutSend specs for the material from ~/.config/itsjustcad/sendcutsend/, else the 50%-of-thickness rule of thumb), then write the cut DXF (1:1, mm by default, $INSUNITS set). Fix any FAIL rows and run it again before uploading. Example: sendcutsend part.dxf 3 aluminum
